column1: # Season s-2026-04 roster: the top six of s-2026-02, replayed.
# The six models that finished on top of s-2026-02: the #1 tie, #3, and the
# three-way tie at 1525.4 that decides who is "fifth". They replay the same
# leaf variants they ran there, so their records are comparable. Six models
# give 30 matches (N(N-1)), which is the largest field under the 40-match cap;
# a seventh model would make 42.
# GLM-5.3 is deliberately in the field twice: Max and Low. Max is the only
# max-effort entry here, and the pair answers the question directly — if Max
# does not fit the context or output budget, Low is the fallback, and the
# season shows what the fallback costs in rating and in dollars.
# The point of the season is the doubt, not the crown: in s-2026-02 almost
# every pair among the top six split 1-1, the #3 model was 10-10 in played
# rounds (four of its wins were opponent no-shows), and three models tied
# exactly at 1525.4 because a balanced round-robin makes the rating a
# function of the all-in record. Two rounds per match double each pair's
# sample.
